Description : Dramatic sea views and stunning, modern architecture set Villa Origami in a league of its own. Every detail of this luxury villa has been thought out and perfectly executed : floor-to-ceiling windows open the home to the vast expanse of the Mediterranean, with views of Gibraltar and the African coast. Soak in your own private infinity pool or lounge in the lavish, cool interior. Private, gorgeous baths in every room.

If desired, we can arrange a private chef, golf outing, yacht rental, or more.

The Essentials:

\- 5 bedrooms (3 double beds, 4 single)

\- 5 en-suite baths

\- Modern, luxurious design

\- Expansive views of the Mediterranean, Gibraltar, and Africa

\- Infinity pool with lounge area

\- Air-conditioned with in-floor heating and cooling

The Details:

Villa Origami was designed by an award-winning architect with one purpose in mind--to create a space where Andalusian luxury is realized to its fullest potential.

You’ll find that we’ve done just that.

Laid out over four floors, every inch of the home has been expertly thought out. Clean, white, linear architecture lends a sense of drama, while natural elements bring everything together for a warm and inviting space.

Glass plays an integral role in the design. You’ll find that every bedroom in the home features views of the Mediterranean, with Gibraltar and the coast of Africa off in the distance. Slide open the windows to seamlessly blend the interior with the beautiful outdoors.

From the terrace, you’re rewarded with similar views as you swim in the infinity pool, enjoy a bottle of champagne on the plush outdoor sofa, or soak in the sun from the comfort of the sleek lounge chairs. In the evenings, you’ll be met with beautiful sunsets as you partake in the outdoor grilling and dining.

Beach clubs, bars, and restaurants of every variety await you just minutes away, and the home comes equipped with a full kitchen featuring plenty of counter space and high-end appliances.

Three bedrooms within the home feature double beds, while the fourth and fifth bedrooms hold two single beds each. All five bedrooms come equipped with soft, plush linens.

All five bedrooms also have their own en-suite bathroom, with his-and-hers vanities and views from the showers and soaking tubs.

Every room in the home is air-conditioned and equipped with both in-floor heating and cooling, ensuring you’ll have a comfortable stay.

For extra entertainment, you’ll find a billiards table in the downstairs bedroom, as well as televisions in every room (with premium international channels), and high-speed WiFi throughout the entire home.

The neighborhood is safe, but feel free to park in the private garage for added security and comfort.

The home overlooks the world-class El Paraiso and Atalaya Golf Clubs, with 54 holes between them. Just five minutes away, you’ll find some of the best golfing on the entire Costa del Sol.

Name-brand luxury shopping can be found just minutes down the road in Puerto Banus.

We’re here to provide help during your stay, and upon request, we’ll arrange for a private chef, golf outing, yacht rental, or more. Don’t hesitate to reach out!

If you’re looking for a luxury experience and beautiful design, look no further.

You’ve found it in Villa Origami.

You’ll have access to the entire home during your stay, including:

\- 5 bedrooms

\- 5 bathrooms

\- Infinity pool with lounge chairs

\- Open living area

\- Indoor & outdoor dining

\- Grill

\- Billiards table

\- Laundry Room

Located just minutes from the coast, Villa Origami sits overlooking El Paraiso Golf Club and the sea. The neighborhood is safe, with walkable sidewalks and well-kept homes.

Designed in 1973 by famous Gary Player, El Paraiso is one of the most established courses on the Costa del Sol. Set out in the beautiful and peaceful El Paraiso valley with the backdrop of the amazing 'La Concha' mountain to the north and the mesmerisiging Mediterranean to the south.

El Paraiso is a long-established residential area that was originally built around the El Paraiso Golf Course in the early 1970s. Since then, it has grown a prestigious residential addresses on Spain’s Costa del Sol.

Located some 8 minutes drive west of Marbella, 6 minutes west of San Pedro and some minutes east of Estepona, El Paraiso is divided into three main sub-zones. : Paraiso Alto and Paraiso Medio lie to the north of the main N-340 coast road, whilst Paraiso Barronal lies to its south, next to the beach. Paraiso Alto is the most northerly and elevated neighborhood of the three.

### Outstanding Villa, Heated Pool, Stunning views in lovely village near Marbella

More than just a standard rental villa as you can see in our over 80 wonderful reviews - because we are a villa that just gets it right..... Remember we have a FREE HEATED POOL so chance for lots of prolonged pool times! High temperature achieved - see reviews

ALSO a key point is - we are within the village, the centre only 8 minutes walking distance to shops, cafes and the famous restaurants! Superb value for a top quality villa. (Our location pin is correct - not like many others ...... beware!)

\\*\\* We can't stress enough how a hot swimming pool and walking distance to shops & restaurants will make a huge difference to your overall experience, this is not to be underestimated\*\*

Villa Paraiso (Paradise!) a large beautifully situated riverside villa with HEATED private pool, Aircon & Super fast fiber optic WiFi, right in the hidden gem of a Spanish village Benahavis; yet only 7 minutes drive to the Coast & nearest beaches & just 15 & 20 minutes to the jet-set resorts of Puerto Banus and Marbella.

Benahavis village is famous for its many restaurants and is known as the 'Dining Room of Andalucia' and is a village that is very positive and welcoming of visitors. Due to its size and enviable location, Villa Paraiso can offer something for everyone. Enjoy the rivers wonderful fresh water swimming hole or the beautiful village park with children’s play area right by the villa. Take an 8 minute stroll into the village centre (700m), where there are shops, tapas bars & restaurants. Relax, dine and soak up the sun in the delightful village square.

Alternatively pick a fresh lemon from the tree at the front gate & simply chill at home in the hammock with a Gin & Tonic, whilst Jose our Paella specialist cooks for you by your own swimming pool!
